title: Unicode stress vectors: naughty strings, Turkish i, bidi, normalization and confusables through mimid's display-text and search paths (and Haven's)
description:
Mark, 2026-11-14 (IETF 127 table), after the English-in-UX sweep and the partialName case-folding finding.

Sources (all third-party or standard; record each with PROVENANCE, commit or version, and license):
- Big List of Naughty Strings, github.com/minimaxir/big-list-of-naughty-strings (MIT): zero-width and bidi controls, combining marks, emoji ZWJ sequences, RTL, case-mapping traps, injection shapes, very long strings.
- Unicode data (unicode.org/Public, a pinned version): NormalizationTest.txt (NFC/NFD pairs), emoji-test.txt, BidiCharacterTest.txt, CaseFolding.txt, and the confusables data.
- Turkish i: I/ı/İ/i under tr and az locales.
- Pseudo-localization: accented, lengthened, bracketed versions of mimid's own strings.

Run them through:
- mimi-content: every text field round-trips byte for byte (no normalization on the wire), and nothing panics.
- mimi-protocol: UTF8String fields (errorDescription, room metadata, IdentifierUri) are accepted or refused per spec, and the decision is the same before and after normalization.
- room-policy display fields (role_name, role_description, bot name): stored and returned exactly as sent.
- identifierQuery partialName and exact search on mimid: say what mimid does today and add a test; compare with the held spec item on case folding (IETF notes/2026-11-14-mimi-issues-from-table-draft.md item 10).
- JMAP projection (Chat.name): what clients get back.
- Then the same vectors against Haven (identifierQuery, room metadata), reported in #mimi or on interop#1 only with Mark's OK.

Output: a fixture file of vectors with expected mimid behaviour, tests that replay it, and beads for any mimid failures. Relates to mimid-1wgh.46.15 (Haven audit fleet), which can reuse the vectors.
notes:
2026-11-14: slice 1 (7f6c417) mimi-content: BLNS db33ec7 vendored (base64 form, MIT, PROVENANCE), every text field round-trips byte for byte, invalid UTF-8 refused, NFC/NFD stay distinct, Turkish i/bidi/ZWJ/BOM/Zalgo hand cases, topicId cap counts octets. Slice 2 (4884730) mimi-protocol: UTF8String keeps every valid entry, refuses invalid UTF-8 and NUL; RoomMetaData carries entries in name/subject/mood/description; IdentifierUri is ASCII-only (non-ASCII user or domain refused until percent-encoded or punycode). mimi-room-policy: role name/description UTF-8 (3.41) keep every valid entry and refuse invalid; bot name/description bytes (3.62) keep every entry. Spec note: room-policy-04 types all four as opaque, so implementations can differ on text vs bytes; added to the IETF language/encoding issue draft. Remaining: normalization-invariance of accept/refuse, identifierQuery search (case folding, confusables), JMAP display paths, Unicode data files (NormalizationTest, CaseFolding, confusables), pseudo-localization, running the same vectors against Haven.
2026-11-14 later: slice 3 (7c5645c) identifierQuery: naughty strings as handles never panic and are notFound; equivalence tests. Change 8761132 (Mark approved): user and room URIs looked up by RFC 3986 §6.2.2 normal form (scheme/host case, hex case, unreserved percent-decoding) in identifierQuery, keyMaterial (routing and serving) and consent (stored keys too); signed values, credentials and participant lists stay byte-for-byte; no case folding or Unicode normalization of the path; deployed 21:58Z and smoke-tested live. Slice 4 (a1d8cd9): all four normalization forms survive as their own bytes in content and UTF8String; IdentifierUri acceptance invariant under NFC/NFD; NFKC turns fullwidth mimi:// into ASCII, so never compatibility-normalize (unicode-normalization 0.1.26 dev-dep, already in lockfile). Spec point added as IETF notes item 11. Remaining: confusables, Unicode data files, pseudo-localization, JMAP display paths, the same vectors against Haven.
2026-11-14 22:3xZ: Haven run (tools/interop/haven/unicode, Haven 34eae7e): content text byte-identical in both for 619 texts x all forms; bodies, invalid UTF-8, IdentifierUri, role names all match. Differences: Haven MimiUri accepts 203 non-ASCII URIs (incl. BOM / U+FFFE host) mimid refuses; Haven role_name limit 1024 octets vs none in mimid/draft. Reported to Jason (pending Mark's OK).
2026-11-15 17:32Z: hub half run against our Haven copy (bafc5e6), driver mode unicode (commit above). Byte-exact matching, no normalization/case folding; percent-encoded handle finds no non-ASCII name; success answers carry raw non-ASCII URIs mimid refuses (110); B/C/D clean. Remaining: confusables, Unicode data files, pseudo-localization, JMAP display paths.
2026-11-19: no one working it; status back to open. Done: mode unicode (byte-exact matching, raw non-ASCII URIs). Remaining: confusables, Unicode data files, pseudo-localization, JMAP display paths.
